facebook.long_form:
RACE RESULT: George Russell wins the 2026 Azerbaijan Grand Prix in Baku.

The final race result from Saturday's chaotic Baku City Circuit race:

🥇 George Russell (Mercedes)
🥈 Max Verstappen (Red Bull) — +0.196s
🥉 Isack Hadjar (Red Bull)
4️⃣ Charles Leclerc (Ferrari)
5️⃣ Kimi Antonelli (Mercedes) — started 16th!

Six drivers retired. Two safety cars. George Russell's third win of the 2026 season.

Antonelli showed massive character in recovering from a Q1 crash to fifth. But Russell kept the pressure on — and the championship gap just got 15 points tighter.

What a race. What a season. 🏎️
facebook.image_caption: RACE WINNER: George Russell takes the Azerbaijan GP 🏆 Third win of 2026. Championship fight very much alive. #F1 #AzerbaijanGP

stories.title: Antonelli's Baku Nightmare — Q1 Crash, P5 Finish, Lead Cut to 66

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
Kimi Antonelli on Baku:

"My worst weekend of 2026."

He crashed in Q1, started P16, finished P5. His championship lead is still 66 points.

302 - 236 - 199 - 186

That's Antonelli — Russell — Hamilton — Norris.

8 rounds left. #F1

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
Kimi Antonelli still leads the 2026 F1 drivers' championship by 66 points.

Next race: Singapore GP, Oct. 9-11.
Format: Sprint weekend (extra points available).

First mathematical window to start closing in on the title. 🏆 #F1 #SingaporeGP

facebook.long_form:
Kimi Antonelli called it "my worst weekend of 2026."

He crashed his Mercedes in Q1 qualifying at Baku, damaging the front-left corner, trackrod, and upright. He had to start 16th — from the back of the grid.

And still finished fifth.

Here's where the 2026 Drivers' Championship stands after Round 15 of 23:

🏆 Kimi Antonelli — 302 pts
2️⃣ George Russell — 236 pts (-66)
3️⃣ Lewis Hamilton — 199 pts (-103)
4️⃣ Lando Norris — 186 pts (-116)
5️⃣ Charles Leclerc — 179 pts
6️⃣ Max Verstappen — 163 pts

Russell took 15 points out of Antonelli's lead in Baku. 66 points is still a significant cushion — but with 8 rounds remaining, including a sprint weekend in Singapore (Oct. 9-11), there is still plenty of racing left.

The next major milestone: Singapore, where Antonelli could begin his first mathematical push toward the title.

Is Antonelli going to hold on? 👇
facebook.image_caption: Antonelli's worst weekend still netted P5 from P16. Championship lead: 66 points. 8 rounds left. The title race is still alive. 🏆 #F1 #AzerbaijanGP

stories.title: Norris Rages at Colapinto — "Some Drivers Shouldn't Be in F1"

x_posts.label: Post 3-1
x_posts.text:
Lando Norris after retiring from Baku (hit by Colapinto):

"Some drivers shouldn't be in F1... I think the FIA should be more strict and start handing out bans for this kind of stuff. It's just careless."

Colapinto accepted responsibility. DNF. 116 pts behind. #F1

x_posts.label: Post 3-2
x_posts.text:
Franco Colapinto caused a Lap 1 restart pile-up at Baku.

Norris, Gasly, AND Colapinto all retired.

Norris wants the FIA to issue bans. Colapinto admitted fault on radio.

What do you think the penalty should be? 👇 #F1 #AzerbaijanGP

facebook.long_form:
Lando Norris did not hold back after retiring from the Azerbaijan Grand Prix.

Here's what happened: At a safety car restart, Franco Colapinto (Alpine) braked too late and smashed into his Alpine teammate Pierre Gasly, who was then collected by Norris. All three drivers — Norris, Gasly, and Colapinto — were forced to retire.

Colapinto accepted responsibility on team radio.

Norris's post-race reaction was one of the most blunt driver statements of the 2026 season:

"Some drivers shouldn't be in F1. I think the FIA should be more strict and start handing out bans for this kind of stuff. It's just careless."

The DNF is crushing for Norris's championship hopes. He's now 116 points behind Antonelli with 8 rounds remaining.

Do you agree with Norris — should the FIA issue race bans for incidents like this? Let us know below. 👇
facebook.image_caption: Norris calls for FIA bans after Colapinto triggered a 3-car retirement at Baku. "Some drivers shouldn't be in F1." The controversy of the weekend. 🔥 #F1 #AzerbaijanGP

stories.title: Aston Martin Double DNF — Fourth of the Season

x_posts.label: Post 4-1
x_posts.text:
Aston Martin suffered their FOURTH double DNF of the 2026 F1 season.

Alonso + Stroll both retired in Baku (China, Barcelona, Italy, and now Baku).

Both started from the back after -45 combined grid penalties.

This team is in crisis. #F1 #AzerbaijanGP

x_posts.label: Post 4-2
x_posts.text:
Lance Stroll's DNF in Baku reportedly set an 18-year F1 DNF frequency record.

Fernando Alonso also retired in the same race.

Aston Martin. Fourth double DNF of 2026. This is not a car problem. This is a team problem. #F1

facebook.long_form:
Fernando Alonso. Lance Stroll. Retired. Again.

The 2026 Azerbaijan Grand Prix saw Aston Martin suffer their FOURTH double DNF of the season (they also retired both cars in China, Barcelona, and Italy).

Both drivers started from the back of the grid, having accumulated a combined 45-place grid penalty for engine changes (Alonso -25, Stroll -20).

Stroll retired on Lap 7 with a water pressure failure at Turn 15. Alonso made it to Lap 21 before a power loss that was costing him 1.5 seconds every lap down the main straight.

And Lance Stroll reportedly set an 18-year F1 record for DNF frequency this season.

At what point does the blame fall on the drivers vs. the car? Comment below. 🤔

facebook.long_form:
After the chaos of Baku, Formula 1 heads to one of the most beautiful and brutal circuits on the calendar.

Singapore Grand Prix — Marina Bay Street Circuit
📅 October 9-11, 2026
📌 Round 18 of 23
⚡ Sprint Weekend (FINAL sprint of the season)

The format:
• Friday Oct. 9: Sprint Qualifying
• Saturday Oct. 10: Qualifying (14:00 BST)
• Sunday Oct. 11: Race (13:00 BST)

This sprint weekend is critical: extra points are on offer, and it's the first realistic window for Kimi Antonelli to begin mathematically pushing toward the 2026 title.

The Marina Bay circuit is unlike anywhere else in F1:
🌡️ Extreme heat and humidity (drivers lose up to 3kg in sweat)
🌙 Night race under floodlights
🏙️ Bumpy street circuit with tight barriers
🏁 One of the slowest average speeds of the season

Antonelli arrives with a 66-point lead and an angry George Russell breathing down his neck. Singapore could change everything.

Are you watching the Singapore GP? Drop your prediction below! 🏁
